chainrings.order: gear 1 first: the smallest chainring, as Shimano numbers the front gears

cassette.order: gear 1 first: the largest sprocket, as Shimano numbers the rear gears

shifters.left: front derailleur in manual mode; in synchro modes it stays on the front by default (one forum report; can be remapped in E-TUBE)

modes.manual: Each shifter moves its own derailleur; nothing shifts by itself.
modes.semi-synchro: Shift mode S1 by default. The rider shifts the front; the rear derailleur shifts by itself by the compensation, so the gear does not jump.
modes.full-synchro: Shift mode S2 by default. The rider shifts the rear only; at the shift points the front derailleur shifts by itself and the rear compensates.

rearCompensation.evidence: default 2: rund-ums-rad.info (50-34 test bike), a Weight Weenies post ('default is 2'), bettershifting; range 1-3 per rund-ums-rad.info, up to 4 per bettershifting

fullSynchro.evidence: Shimano dealer's manual DM-RARD010-03 (text excerpt via search): the front switches when the rear is at 7th gear on the small ring and at 2nd gear on the large ring, counted from the largest sprocket. rund-ums-rad.info measured the default on 50-34 / 11-28 (11-speed): 2.27 -> 2.63 (34x15 -> 50x19) and 2.0 -> 1.62 (50x25 -> 34x21), which are exactly these gear positions with 2 sprockets of compensation. Not confirmed for 12-speed: applied here by gear position.

unconfirmed: fullSynchro.shiftPoints: the gear positions are the 11-speed default (DM-RARD010-03, measured by rund-ums-rad.info); that 12-speed R8100/R7100 uses the same positions is not confirmed
the left shifter's default in full synchro (one forum report: still the front derailleur)
multiple shift defaults (start delay, interval, maximum)

multipleShift.holdingShifts: several gears while the button is held
multipleShift.settings: start delay, interval and maximum number of gears in E-TUBE
multipleShift.evidence: ctyeh.com guide (settings exist, recommends 300-500 ms and 3-4 gears, not Shimano's defaults); rund-ums-rad.info (keeps shifting while held, at most 3 steps)

blockedCombinations.evidence: bettershifting: Gear Position Control is not enabled on 12-speed Ultegra/105 Di2 rear derailleurs, so the smallest sprockets can be used on the small ring; the 'no 11/12 on 34' lock reported for older 11-speed systems does not apply
